scope: Independent read-only archive/source/inventory audit; no rebuild, native execution or repeated scientific tests.
checks: Five bounded transport ZIP digests/CRCs verified; source parts reconstruct the exact frozen source SHA-256. All three candidate archive hashes/sizes/CRCs/safe member paths match build records and checksum manifest.
Complete baseline/candidate core inventories verified; all 143 Starter pack files and pins are unchanged; no unowned application files present.
Every packaged current source file exactly matches candidate Git objects, and the curated source selection is complete; runtime workspace files match source.
Packaged production source exactly matches reviewed publisher JSON identity and owner fingerprint; exact 32-pack profile/lock are retained.
Source availability metadata pins the verified source archive and preserved legacy/pack source companions.
Updater inventory, exact replacement set/bytes, target manifest, runtime/licences, and transaction source all match the candidate; no pack/user paths are replacements and no files are obsolete.
limitations: Static verification binds source files and metadata but does not independently rebuild PE binaries.
User-data preservation is established here only by update scope; actual preservation and live production setup require separate exact-package Windows evidence.
